_comment: Maps Microsoft 10-K raw label text to standard canonical keys. Keys are lowercase for case-insensitive matching. Microsoft FY2023 10-K uses 'revenue' for top-line and 'gross margin' for gross profit.

_notes.selling_general_administrative: Microsoft splits SG&A into 'sales and marketing' + 'general and administrative'. We map both to the same standard key. During extraction you will need to decide which one to use, or sum them.
_notes.total_operating_expenses: Microsoft calls this 'total operating expenses' — verify exact wording in the PDF during extraction.
